title: Drowning
_note: Drowning lands on the lungs alone (part_weights). The lungs have no cap and are outside the health capacity; their stage is the lung damage as a share of max health (lungs.medium / lungs.severe). See guide.md.

text.feels_intro: How {name}'s lungs feel after nearly drowning; let this shape {his} tone, breathing and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

lungs: {name}'s breathing: a little ragged, with a wet cough now and then; water drips from {his} hair and nose.
{name}'s breathing: labored and rattling, broken by fits of coughing that bring up water; {his} lips are pale and tinged blue and {his} eyes are red and streaming.
{name}'s breathing: shallow, wet and gurgling, each breath a struggle; {his} lips and fingertips are blue, {his} skin is grey and clammy, and pink froth flecks {his} mouth.
{name}'s chest feels tight and {his} throat stings from the water. {name} is shaken, coughing and catching {his} breath.
{name}'s lungs burn with every breath and a deep, wet ache sits under {his} ribs. {name} is frightened and exhausted, gasping between coughing fits and unable to speak more than a few words.
{name}'s lungs are on fire and every breath drags like wet sand; the world swims at the edges. {name} is terrified and barely conscious, clawing for air and unable to stand or speak.

levels: , {name}'s breath finally running out. {name} chokes and swallows water, chest heaving as the urge to breathe takes over.
, while {name}'s chest is already burning. {name} chokes on more water, thrashing toward the surface.
, and {name}'s struggles grow weak. Water floods in with every helpless gasp and the light above fades.
, and it is too much. {name} stops struggling, limbs drifting, the last bubbles slipping from {name}'s lips.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to ease {own} burning lungs.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to ease {own} burning lungs.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The burning in {name}'s lungs is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the burning from {own} lungs, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s lungs are clear again, and {name} breathes deep and easy.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s lungs are clear again, and {name} breathes deep and easy.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s lungs are clear again, and {name} breathes deep and easy.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} lungs are {progress}.

lungs: {name}'s last breath leaves in a stream of silver bubbles and water rushes in to take its place. {name}'s body convulses, fingers clawing at nothing, then goes slack, drifting with open, unseeing eyes and hair floating around a blue-lipped face.

{name} thrashes toward the light, mouth opening on water instead of air; the chest heaves against the flood until the struggling slows, then stops. {name}'s body hangs limp in the water, pale and bloated-lipped, a thin pink froth at the mouth.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, a cloud of shit and piss spreads into the water around {name}.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, clouding the water around {name}'s body.
